title: Triage reads a PR's lane from the PR itself before it relays a message about that PR
why: At 09:57 CST Nov 8 triage sent the #1969 and #1516 clash to the wrong lane: it took the lane of a step whose note mentioned #1969, not the lane named on #1969.
note: Filed 09:59 CST Nov 8 by triage for its own mistake (rule building-mistake-names-its-guard). Fix: a small reader prints a PR's head branch and the session its body footer names, and the waiting-page and roadmap skills tell triage to run it before relaying about a PR. Red case: #1969, whose footer names session_013NEJKzjkypcToggneCjJN8.
